metadata.description: Code Knowledge Graph (CKG) — structure-aware retrieval for coding agents. Parse codebases into typed graphs (import/call/co-edit edges), store in Oracle AI Database 26ai Free PGQ, and inject a dependency-aware structure map before every prompt so Claude Code finds the right files faster.

plugins.name: ckg
plugins.description: Code Knowledge Graph — transparent background dependency analysis. Builds a typed code graph and injects a compact structure map into every prompt (anchors + 2-hop import/call/co-edit reach), verified to cut tool calls by ~22% and reach correct files ~36% sooner on real features.
